text: Implemented optional fixed-mass conditional-gradient audit with exact lpSolve dominated-marginal oracle, deterministic boundary-refined line search, final gap, feasibility/objective traces, and alignment diagnostics. Fixed fixture court passes structural-start energy/coverage/warp/barycentric/rank stability, candidate-order permutation, and optimized/reference parity (polished score difference 1.83e-13; max feasibility 2.22e-16). Objective improved 2.87e-4, but 20-run mean pair time rose from 0.00165s to 0.21950s (~133x) and strict 1e-7 gap was not reached in 30 updates, so polish remains opt-in audit and entropic remains default. POT unavailable and not required. Aggregate Transport-v3 focused court passes.
